title: FlyBee
description: Ride bees, fly freely, and explore the world from above.
body:
> **Required dependency: HoneycombTools 1.1.0+**

Ride bees and fly freely through the world.

Attach a **Honeycomb Saddle** to any vanilla bee to convert it into a rideable mount.
Control with W/A/S/D, Space to ascend, Ctrl to descend, hover automatically when idle.

English/Japanese AutoSwitch

### Saddles
- **Honeycomb Saddle** — standard speed, consumes Pollen Bottles as fuel
- **Quality Honeycomb Saddle** — 1.9× speed, consumes fuel
- **Supreme Honeycomb Saddle** — 1.9× speed, no fuel needed

### Bee Armor
- **Iron** — immune to mob attacks
- **Gold** — immune to player attacks
- **Diamond** — fully invulnerable (except void / `/kill`)

### Other Features
- **Bee Totem** — revives your bee on death; 2% drop chance
- **Bee Backpack** — carry your bee as an item
- **Name tag** your bee to enable follow mode and owner-lock
- **Hay-fever effect** — drink a Pollen Bottle and sneeze
- **12 advancements**

### Dependencies
- **[Honeycombtools 1.1.2+](https://modrinth.com/mod/honeycombtools)** — required
- **Patchouli** — optional (enables the in-game guide book)
